equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity is not analysed; age groups are stratified only for the June 1–5 vs June 7 comparison; no race or social-position data were analysed.

notes: Stratified pre/post comparisons by region and age are explicitly labelled stratified, so the depth is stratified/adjusted; the Pearson correlation is the only computed estimate and carries no test or CI. Percent changes and baseline ratios are arithmetic, not procedures.
view_issues: The Preliminary Conclusions call the Eastern Lake Ontario (179.1%) and Central (132.8%) increases 'twofold', which understates the reported increases (about 2.8-fold and 2.3-fold).
